title: Scholar Schema: a structured academic publishing system
description: Scholar Schema is a structured academic publishing system for microjournals, journal club records and other structured academic writing. A base schema holds the fields every article shares; each article schema builds on it and adds type-specific fields. Articles are written in Markdown and checked against their schemas; the system builds each article's web page, a matching PDF with its own page count, and its entry in an issue. Issues collect published articles automatically, article schemas are locked once used by a published article, and an optional workflow gives each published article a Zenodo DOI, with a sandbox mode for testing. Built with Jekyll, Python (ReportLab) and GitHub Actions; published on GitHub Pages. Designed and specified by the author; implemented with AI-assisted programming under the author's direction.
